decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of 'The Girl on the Train'. The source documents describe three distinct films with this title: the 2013 film (D1S1), the 2016 film (D4S1), and the 2009 film (D5S3). Each has a different director explicitly named in the text: Larry Brand (2013), Tate Taylor (2016), and André Téchiné (2009). Since the question does not specify a year, all three valid directors are accepted as distinct valid referents. Candidate C3 (Quentin Tarantino) is rejected because D3S1 contains a note (D3S2) explicitly stating the context was modified to replace Larry Brand with Tarantino, making it a false assertion rather than a factual source.
